narration.text: [whispers] You're the overnight guest. It's two fifty-eight in the morning. The storm just stopped. [long pause] [softly] Monte Cristo Homestead. Junee, New South Wales. Built in the eighteen eighties by the Crawley family. [long pause] Mister Crawley died here in nineteen ten. His wife stayed on, and rarely left the house again. [long pause] For decades, guests who spent the night have reported footsteps on the balcony. Voices. Being touched. [long pause] No one has ever proven anything. The house closed to visitors in twenty twenty-five. [long pause] You hear the footsteps now. On the balcony, outside your door. [long pause] Something touches your shoulder. [long pause] [whispers] Turn the camera around.
